summary: Pack 9/9 Manuel d'utilisation — Full backend + frontend verification. All 12 backend pytest tests pass (16 modules seeded, role filter, module detail with read flag, progress mark/get, search, module-for-path, admin PATCH, rider forbidden). Full frontend flow verified: sidebar entry, Manuel home with 16 cards, 6 role filter buttons, rider filter → 4 cards (modules 1/2/5/16), search 'livraison' → 6 results dropdown, Module 3 detail page with TOC(16), objectives, 12 steps, callout-warning, prev/next, mark-read persists with 'Lu' badge, admin edit button visible (hidden for rider), Help button on /console/pos opens side panel scoped to Module 3 (Caisse), guided tour appears on first login after localStorage clear with close/prev/next/finish buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_manual_modules() guards with count>=16 so existing seeded modules are not updated when MANUAL_MODULES_SEED code changes; consider upsert-by-number to keep seed content aligned with code.
GET /manual/search is a linear scan over all modules; fine for 16 items but should be indexed if content grows.

Rider role cannot access /console/* routes so /console/manuel is admin/manager/sales/stock only; rider help/manual is implicitly gated by role route guard — role filter is still exposed in server for completeness.
seed_data_creation: None (16 manual modules auto-seeded on backend startup)
